configuration_reports.label: yes
controls_available: Primary-pointer hold: press the visible moving pressure pad and keep the held pointer on the pad, using pointer_tracking moves; pointerup, pointercancel, lost capture, blur, or leaving the pad long enough ends and resets the hold.
Keyboard route: WASD or arrow keydown actions emit N/E/S/W moves while the pressure hold is active.
Static course: 9 columns x 7 rows with 1 alternating relay/checkpoint; the generated route is constrained to 7-12 accepted moves.

Moving-pressure contract: period 4800 ms; x amplitude 155-175 milli-units; y amplitude 95-115 milli-units; hit ellipse radii 270 x 310 milli-units; sample interval 140 ms; maximum gap 520 ms; outside grace 460 ms; minimum continuous hold 3000 ms.
REISSUE COURSE is an administrative failure/restart control.
autonomous_processes: From render onward, requestAnimationFrame updates the pressure pad continuously according to its elapsed-time sinusoid; no agent action is needed for the plate to move.

During a full hold, each frame tests the held pointer against the moving hit ellipse, records in-pad samples every 140 ms, and starts the outside-grace reset process when the pointer is out of the pad.
The route vehicle, accepted position, and checkpoint index change only after keyboard actions; there is no autonomous course motion.
The continuity bar advances with elapsed hold time, and once the dock, route, minimum hold, and recent-sample conditions are satisfied, maybeComplete submits without another route action.
A reset may play a short CSS rewind animation; that animation is visual feedback rather than an independent outcome mechanism.
grouped_control_modes: D_full_pointer_tracking (common witness): pointer_tracking hold-start and pointer-move actions across all full-mode holds, rounds, and attempts.
D_full_keyboard_route: keyboard WASD/arrow actions that change the static route position and checkpoint progress.
REISSUE COURSE is administrative and is not an outcome-affecting grouped mode.

clause_i.reason: For D_full_pointer_tracking, an observation-free q cannot choose the pointer-down/tracking coordinate for every history with the same I_t: the generator randomizes phase and also varies period and amplitudes, while I_t contains no current plate position.

clause_ii.reason: The configured W_t^500 contains five chronological frames across 500 ms. The visible pad position and its recent direction/trajectory support a bounded-window policy g that predicts the plate center at t+1000 ms and places the pointer there; no private phase or page state is required.

clause_iii.reason: Use D_full_pointer_tracking before hold start at a visible plate center and a phase where the plate moves far enough during Delta=1000 ms: the same stale pointer-down coordinate is outside the hit ellipse at delivery, while success remains possible by starting the hold later. The selected horizons are within the active pressure opportunity and the strict loss is caused by the plate's visible non-clock motion, not by a deadline.

configuration_reports.common_visible_process: The common process is the visibly moving pressure plate: its sinusoidal motion is evidenced by the five-frame window, determines the delayed pointer target, and makes the stale full-mode pointer-down/tracking action strictly less effective after 1000 ms.

pre_run.reason: Every generated full instance has a nonzero required route (the generated route is constrained to 7-12 accepted moves.) and the grader requires accepted movement events inside one continuous hold. Starting the hold and then sending no outcome-affecting actions cannot reach the dock; the source therefore rules out a successful pre-run solution for at least half of instances without inventing a rate.
